authorizedImplementation.trustedSnapshotConstraint: The module may implement only the fail-closed trusted snapshot ports inside its exact boundary. It must not edit central marker/Auth protocol paths and must never treat the admitted marker v1 alone as a complete authority snapshot. A 202 result is permitted only when an allowed complete snapshot and the exact post-receipt Auth equality are both proven.

migrationAuthority.validateOnly: VALIDATED, REJECTED or DUPLICATE items only; accepted/applied/quarantined counts zero; source equals derived validated item count plus rejected plus duplicate
migrationAuthority.apply: REJECTED, DUPLICATE, APPLIED or QUARANTINED_AFTER_ACCEPTANCE items only; source equals accepted plus rejected plus duplicate; accepted equals applied plus quarantined
